crossRefs.note: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and…

translations.web: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees, and spreading them on the road.
translations.bsb: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.
translations.kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
translations.asv: And many spread their garments upon the way; and others branches, which they had cut from the fields.
